name: falconsh
description: Run any coding agent with any LLM in absolute privacy. Currently support Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.

scripts.build: tsup src/cli.ts --format esm --target node20 --clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f='dist/cli.js';fs.writeFileSync(f,'#!/usr/bin/env node\n'+fs.readFileSync(f));" && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.check:all: pnpm run check:types && pnpm run check:format && pnpm run check:lint
scripts.launch:claude-auth-status: pnpm run dev -- launch claude -m auto auth status
scripts.launch:claude-it: pnpm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m openrouter/free
scripts.launch:claude-with-prompt: pnpm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m openrouter/free -p 'Who is your model maker?' --system-prompt 'You are a concise assistant.'
scripts.launch:claude-with-prompt-haiku: pnpm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m ~anthropic/claude-haiku-latest --system-prompt 'You are a concise assistant.' -p 'Who is your model maker?'
scripts.launch:claude-with-anthropic-gateway: pnpm run dev -- launch claude --verbose -m claude-haiku-4-5 -p 'Who is your model maker?' --system-prompt 'You are a concise assistant.'
scripts.launch:codex-auth-status: export CODEX_HOME=~/.falcon/codex && pnpm run dev -- launch codex -m auto login status
scripts.launch:codex-it: export CODEX_HOME=~/.falcon/codex && pnpm run dev -- launch codex -m openrouter/free
scripts.launch:codex-with-prompt: export CODEX_HOME=~/.falcon/codex && pnpm run dev -- launch codex -m openrouter/free -p 'Who is your model maker?'
scripts.launch:opencode-with-prompt: pnpm run dev -- launch opencode -m deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash:free -p 'Who is your model maker?'
scripts.launch:claude-installer: PATH=/bin FALCON_DIR=/tmp/falcon-clean-test-dir pnpm run dev -- launch claude
